PROXY.description: HTTP(S) proxy URL to use during debootstrap (e.g., http://proxy.example.com:3128/). Leave empty to disable.

MIRROR.description: Base URL of the package mirror to use for debootstrap. Empty string means use default (Debian stable).

ARCH.description: Target architecture (e.g., 'amd64', 'i386'). Empty string means use host architecture.

SUITE.description: Debian/Ubuntu suite (release codename or status like 'stable', 'unstable'). Empty string means use debootstrap default (stable).

EXTRA_PKGS.description: Comma-separated list of extra packages to install during debootstrap.

COMPONENTS.description: Comma-separated list of components to pass to debootstrap (e.g., 'main,contrib,non-free'). Empty string means use default ('main').

CUSTOMIZE_DIR.description: Directory containing hook scripts to run during instance customization (run-parts format).

GENERATE_CACHE.description: Whether to generate cache files during debootstrap ('yes' or other).

CLEAN_CACHE.description: Number of days after which to clean cache files. Empty string disables cache cleaning.

PARTITION_STYLE.description:
Partitioning style for the target device ('none', 'msdos').
      "enum": [
        "none",
        "msdos"
      ]
